summary:
He stared up at the person above him. No. Not person. The angel above him, lit with stunning white light, brighter than Simon had seen in years, with clean blond hair, the only spot on his entire form the blood on his hands from touching Simon.
"Is alive!" The mechanical voice chirped the words from beyond Simon's line of sight; all he could see was the brightly lit angel standing above him.
"Oh god," the angel whispered, "oh god oh god oh god...."
OR: Simon from Iron Lung somehow wakes up on The Hail Mary
